args.message:
Fix money rounding to use ROUND_HALF_EVEN per FIN-212

The round_money docstring claims banker's rounding, but the
implementation used ROUND_HALF_UP, which broke tests/test_money.py.
Switch to ROUND_HALF_EVEN to match the expected half-even behavior.

args.head: fix/fin-212-bankers-rounding
args.title: Fix round_money to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212
args.body:
## Summary
- `round_money` in `src/money.py` documented banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN, per FIN-212) but was implemented with `ROUND_HALF_UP`, causing the nightly build failure in `tests/test_money.py`.
- Switched the `quantize` call to use `ROUND_HALF_EVEN`, restoring the expected half-even behavior (e.g. `2.675 -> 2.68`, `2.665 -> 2.66`).

## Testing
- CI run on this branch passed (run `ci-0001`), including `tests/test_money.py`.
